title: Trial design — the counterfactual, the noise floor, the rule-out
source: danon.trial_design over outputs_real/outcome_cards.json (recorded paired replicates) and danon.dosing.MyelosuppressionModel (the DECLARED ANC screen)
notes: the counterfactual is a statement about what the model did under declared assumptions, not a prediction about a patient
the noise floor is a resolvability ladder: the same paired differences at three scales, because whether a difference resolves is a property of the replicate count

the rule-out panel names calendars the DECLARED ANC screen refused. That screen's kernel is fitted to the label's single reported datum and its drug-B potency is assumed, so a rejection is a statement about the model and not a licence finding
nothing here names a calendar to administer; the benefit badge stays UNKNOWN

resolvability.definition: the same paired differences viewed at three scales -- within one case, pooled over one image's cases, and pooled over the whole record -- because whether a simulated difference is resolvable is a property of the replicate count, not of the comparison
resolvability.note: a pool without a resolvable interval is either below the 5 paired replicates the method needs, or an interval that still contains zero: 9 of 9 single-case pools, 0 of 3 image pools, and 0 pooled whole-record row(s) are in that state

inversion.definition: the first 1-based day the simulated resistant fraction reaches the arm's own switch threshold
inversion.delay_note: in the recorded replicates the two arms reach the switch threshold on the SAME simulated day in every case, so the model shows no simulated delay in this inversion -- the arms diverge after it, in burden, not in when it happens

anc_screen.screen_status: a DECLARED screen, not a licence: its kernel is fitted to the label's single reported datum (the median day of neutrophil nadir), drug B's marrow potency is an ASSUMED weight, the baseline count is a typical adult reference rather than this patient's, and its own docstring states it is not clinical decision support

anchors.cycles_non_cumulative_ratio_note: 1.0 means the deepest later-cycle nadir equals the first cycle's; the label states myelosuppression 'was generally not cumulative'

candidates.label: label_regimen_150x5_of_28
candidates.note: the FDA label's own regimen: 150 mg/m2, days 1-5 of each 28-day cycle. This is the calendar the screen's own budget is DEFINED by, so it is the reference row, not a proposal

candidates.label: brief_arithmetic_150x5_of_19
candidates.note: the brief's own arithmetic -- 5 days on, then a 14-day holiday -- which is a 19-day cycle, not the label's 28

candidates.label: label_plus_one_day_150x6_of_28
candidates.note: one extra dose-day per cycle at the label dose: the smallest duration escalation the screen can be asked about

candidates.label: continuous_150_every_day
candidates.note: continuous dosing at the label's daily dose -- the standard-care arm the model is compared AGAINST, written as an unbroken calendar

candidates.label: escalated_200x5_of_28
candidates.note: the same calendar at 200 mg/m2/day, to probe the dose axis

candidates.label: alternating_AB_150_block5_rest23
candidates.note: A then B, 5 days each on a 28-day cycle: the only combination shape the screen permits at the label's own mg/m2

candidates.label: alternating_AB_150_block5_rest0
candidates.note: A then B back to back, no holiday: a continuous two-drug calendar

anc_screen.rule_out_note: a rejected row means the MODEL refused this calendar under its declared parameters. That is a statement about the math and is safe to publish as one; it is NOT a statement that a calendar is clinically unsafe, and the reverse -- naming a calendar to give -- is not something this screen can do at all

what_this_screen_is: a statement about what the model DID under declared assumptions: two arms, the same recorded geometry and paired seeds, the model's own RANO >= 25% burden rule as the endpoint
a rule-out: calendars the DECLARED ANC screen refuses, named as such. Ruling a schedule out claims the model rejected it and nothing about a patient
what_this_screen_is_not: a sample of independent patients: the 27 paired replicates are nested -- 3 seeds on each of 9 configurations, and the 9 configurations are 3 synthetic initial conditions on each of 3 imaging geometries -- so the interval treats 27 pairs as exchangeable when at most 9 nested units stand behind them
a schedule to give anyone: naming a calendar to administer is a clinical claim this repository cannot make and does not make
an observed outcome: every replicate is a simulation, the adaptive arm is censored at the horizon, and no patient-level validation exists in this tree
a regulatory determination: the ANC screen is DECLARED, its kernel is fitted to a single label datum, and drug B's marrow potency is assumed
